title: Represented Ext classes transfer before open localization
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism and $G$ an abelian sheaf. Let $I$ resolve $G$ and $J$ resolve $g^*G$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $\alpha:I\to g_*J$ satisfy the degree-zero augmentation equation $I.\iota^0\alpha^0=\mathrm{unit}_G\,g_*(J.\iota^0)$. For an open $W$ and $q\geq0$, let $f_X:A_W\to I^q$ and $f_Y:A_{g^{-1}W}\to J^q$ be cocycles, with $A$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-object-cohomology-map]. Assume their sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-comparison-data] satisfy $\mathrm{sections}(f_Y)=T_W^q(\mathrm{sections}(f_X))$, with $T$ the explicit transfer [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer]. With $k$ from [def-weil-pbc-etale-open-free-sheaf-pullback], $J.\mathrm{extMk}(f_Y)=\mathrm{mk}_0(k)\circ g^*(I.\mathrm{extMk}(f_X))$ in $\mathrm{Ext}^q(A_{g^{-1}W},g^*G)$, before applying any open-object cohomology map.

source.place: https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01F8 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01FB (resolution functoriality); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A50 (section complexes)

proof.text: Construct e:g*I→J degreewise by the inverse homEquiv applied to α. Apply homEquiv injectivity and its left/right naturality to prove the chain-map equations. Left naturality of the inverse equivalence, hα, right naturality, and homEquiv_id show g*(I.ι⁰)e⁰=J.ι⁰. The chain-map equation and hfX show that g*(fX)e^q is closed.

Apply exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle with coefficient morphism the identity of g*G, comparison e and its augmentation equation. The exactness and additivity instances of upperStar discharge the functor assumptions. Simplify composition with Ext.mk₀ of the identity to obtain the image of I.extMk fX as J.extMk(g*(fX)e^q).

Apply sectionsEquiv injectivity to identify k followed by g*(fX)e^q with fY. Expand k via its defining inverse sectionsEquiv and cancel apply_symm_apply. Unit naturality and homEquiv.apply_symm_apply give unit followed by g_*(g*(fX)e^q)=fX followed by α^q. Evaluate this equality with sectionsEquiv, using sectionsEquiv_naturality. Naturality_apply of the sheaf morphism moves its component across restriction along openSectionPullback. The resulting equality is hsections after expanding openResolutionSectionTransfer. Finally use InjectiveResolution.mk₀_comp_extMk and substitute the equality of cocycles.

from.place: The augmentation-preserving open transfer part of the resolution-section comparison; the Ext calculation after choosing Hom cocycles. Split the represented Ext transfer from localization/generator compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem resolutionSection_transfer_ext
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution G)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G))
    (α : I.cocomplex ⟶
      ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 =
      (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).unit.app G ≫
        (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (W : X.Opens) (q : ℕ)
    (fX : (etaleOpenFreeSheaf X).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι) ⟶ I.cocomplex.X q)
    (hfX : fX ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (fY : (etaleOpenFreeSheaf Y).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι) ⟶ J.cocomplex.X q)
    (hfY : fY ≫ J.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (hsections : EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv Y.smallEtaleTopology
      (Scheme.Etale.mk (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι) (J.cocomplex.X q) fY =
      (openResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α W).f q
        (EtaleOpenComparison.sectionsEquiv X.smallEtaleTopology
          (Scheme.Etale.mk W.ι) (I.cocomplex.X q) fX)) :
    J.extMk fY (q + 1) rfl hfY =
      (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (etaleOpenFreeSheafPullback g W)).comp
        ((I.extMk fX (q + 1) rfl hfX).mapExactFunctor
          (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g)) (zero_add q)
